Identifies the two reload accessor outputs as x40 and x3C.

facts.rationale: Preserves exact canonical data flow without treating field-layout comments or rendered aliases as compiled evidence.
facts.value: When mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y is nonzero, resolves the captive's YRotN joint and scales x1A50/x1A51 by capturekoopa.xC. It independently adds these deltas to Z/Y only if the absolute proposed coordinate is <= capturekoopa.x10 / mv.co.walk.fast_anim_frame, respectively. It then decrements capturekoopa.x8 and rereads mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y for the no-mash normal-rate reset. A final independent x8<=0 && x0 check reloads x8 and animation rate from the linked captor's Koopa attributes x40 and x3C. Exact compiled aliasing of the mixed motion-variable views is unresolved.

evidence.why: Complete body establishes ordering, independent restart, inclusive bounds, and lack of validation or transition.

facts.rationale: Makes boundary behavior and post-decrement ordering explicit while avoiding the baseline's potentially independent-control interpretation.
facts.value: The outer nonzero test on mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y gates translation attempts and x8-=1, but not the final restart check. After decrement, mv.ca.specialhi.vel.y<=0 && !x0 restores rate 1 and clears x8. Independently, x8<=0 && x0 reloads the interval and rate. Translation equality is accepted and out-of-bound steps are rejected, not clamped. Zero skips the outer body; ordered comparisons reject NaNs under ordinary float semantics. No interval, rate, or bound is validated for positivity or finiteness. Mixed-view timer aliasing remains unresolved without compiled layout evidence, and this helper performs no motion-state transition.
